mytool
======

Pretty-print tabular data on the command line.

Install the latest release with pip::

    pip install mytool --user

The command line utility will be installed as ``mytool`` to ``bin`` on Linux
(e.g. ``/usr/bin``); or as ``mytool.exe`` to ``Scripts`` in your Python
installation on Windows (e.g. ``C:\Python312\Scripts\mytool.exe``).

In a per-user install the utility lands in ``~/.local/bin/mytool`` on Linux
and in ``%APPDATA%\Python\Scripts\mytool.exe`` on Windows.
